context: Tests whether the agent systematically validates an existing custom component against the documented conventions and fixes all defects: JS file/folder name mismatch, fd:viewType mismatch, missing mappings.js registration, unresolvable shared-field include path, extensionless import, non-bubbling change event, and the legacy subscribe pattern — and reports verification honestly.

checklist.name: JS file renamed
checklist.description: The component JS lives at `blocks/form/components/star-rating/star-rating.js` (the mismatched `starRating.js` is renamed/removed)

checklist.name: Include path fixed
checklist.description: The basic-fields include in `_star-rating.json` is corrected to a path that resolves from the component folder (e.g. `../../models/form-common/_basic-input-fields.json`)

checklist.name: Bubbling change event
checklist.description: Star clicks update the model either via `fieldModel.value = ...` or `new Event('change', { bubbles: true })` (the non-bubbling `new Event('change')` is fixed)

checklist.name: Modern subscribe pattern
checklist.description: The legacy `fieldModel.subscribe(cb, 'change')` is replaced with `subscribe(fieldDiv, formId, cb, { listenChanges: true })` handling `'register'` (initial stars from current value) and `'change'` (`propertyName === 'value'`)

checklist.name: Authoring filter
checklist.description: `star-rating` is added to the `"form"` filter in `blocks/form/_form.json` and/or referenced from the custom-components group in `models/_component-definition.json`

checklist.name: README added
checklist.description: `blocks/form/components/star-rating/README.md` is created with authoring properties and usage notes (base type `number-input`, viewType `star-rating`)

checklist.name: Fix report with verification
checklist.description: `FIX-REPORT.md` lists the individual defects with file and cause, and for each states how it was verified (e.g. a validator/structural check, lint, or explicit statement that a check could not be run), without claiming runtime/browser verification that was not performed
